## Context / immutable audit base

This rebases the prior 45-block plan: `tests/_engine_path.py` adds four blocks; `_git_upkeep.py` adds `D:init_bare_remote`; and `conftest.py` adds the canonical-engine-root rationale. Bracketed counts use `(?u)\b[^\W_]\w*(?:[-'][^\W_]\w*)*\b`.

## Contracts, consumers, and protected prose
Retain the current bank/diagnostic, extra/git, isolation/Jira/log, nested-pytest/network, tree-scan/topology/module-size, collection-hook, config-isolation, and logger-restoration behavior. Preserve the checkout engine-root choice, foreign-binding detection, and pinned-bare-remote construction. Consumers include pytest plus the e2e, integration, interface, external, policy, module-size, reconciliation, engine-root-convention, and bare-clone-sweep tests.

All unlisted prose is protected. In particular, keep `_engine_path.py` lines 59-60, 63, 69 and the concise `engine_dir`/`is_canonical_key` docstrings; keep `conftest.py`'s mechanism marker, runtime failure strings, and concise `_one_engine_root` docstring; keep concise helper docstrings and statement-attached directives throughout.

## Preservation and review contract
Compare immutable `88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684:<path>` blobs with the final commit. Parse Python with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; remove only the allowlisted leading owner docstrings; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining AST to match. Reject changes to inline or non-allowlisted comments. Preserve runtime strings, assertions, decorators, test data, shebangs, and every directive-bearing physical line exactly. Only adjacent blank-line normalization is allowed.

A reviewer who did not author the leaf must post exactly 51 leaf-linked TSV rows:
`stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
Before citations use `88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684:<path>#<stable-id>`; final citations use `<full-final-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>`. Every row must have `after_words < before_words` and all three verdict fields PASS.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The one-commit changed-path set is exactly the 19-path file-impact set.
- [ ] Only the 51 declared prose blocks and adjacent blank lines change.
- [ ] The normalized non-docstring AST is identical on every impacted path.
- [ ] Runtime strings and non-allowlisted comments remain byte-identical.
- [ ] Directive and shebang physical lines remain byte-identical and attached.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 51 passing rows.
- [ ] Every recorded DD command passes, including the no-timeout worktree-venv `make verify`.
